title: Birth, First Cry & First Cuddles
desc: The most extraordinary day of our lives — you arrived, you cried, and we held you close for the very first time.
story: After hours of waiting and hoping, you made your grand entrance into the world on the 13th of January 2026 at 1:42 in the morning. The room was buzzing with the quiet urgency of the midwives, and then there you were. Tiny, perfect, and entirely ours. Nothing could have prepared us for that feeling. Moments later you cried for the first time. That little voice, strong and clear, was the most beautiful sound we had ever heard. In that single cry, you announced yourself to the world. Within minutes you were placed on Mum's chest, skin to skin, warm and wriggling. Dad leaned in close with one hand resting gently on your tiny back. The three of us stayed like that for what felt like forever. You settled almost immediately, as if you already knew exactly where you belonged.
